In the NHL, Crosby has captained the Pittsburgh Penguins to three Stanley Cup championships. One iconic moment came in 2009 during Game 4 of the Stanley Cup Final, where Crosby scored a crucial game-winning goal to tie the series against Detroit, ultimately leading the Penguins to a seven-game victory and his first Stanley Cup championship. In March 2018, Crosby showcased his incredible hand-eye coordination by juggling the puck to himself before batting it out of the air and into the net. Another standout moment occurred during the 2016 Stanley Cup Final against Tampa Bay in Game 2, where Crosby netted the overtime winner to even the series at home. That year, he claimed the Conn Smythe Trophy, an honor he would win again the following season.

Then, during the 2022 Stanley Cup Final against the Tampa Bay Lightning, Makar struck again with a shorthanded goal in Game 2. Starting on the penalty kill in the defensive zone, he collected the puck near the slot and led a 2-on-1 rush, finishing with a pinpoint wrist shot into the far side of the net. 
Earlier in those same playoffs, during the First Round against the Nashville Predators, Makar delivered another highlight-reel goal that displayed his speed, creativity, and elusiveness. After gaining possession near the offensive blue line, he evaded pressure with a quick deke, skated down the wall, and finished by shelving the puck past the netminder. Makar led all defensemen during the 2022 Stanley Cup Playoffs with 8 goals, 21 assists and 29 points.
